messages.subject: DT formatStyle() Error
parts:
I have a DT that relies on many inputs to subset the DT to the appropriate data then visualize the data with color-coding to match a different UI element in the application.

The application runs flawlessly when I do not use %>% formatStyle. However, when I do use it I get the errors below only when subsetting the data in a particular way.
  • Firefox -  SyntaxError: missing } after property list htmlwidgets.js:2:70
  • Chrome - VM470:2 Uncaught SyntaxError: Unexpected string -
    • (function(row, data) {
      var value=data[1]; if (value!==null) $(row).css({'background-color':''''});
      })

In other words, the color-coding works in 70% of the situations, but when a UI element is subsetted based on a different UI element AND formatStyle is "ON" then the UI element does not update causing the visualizations not to update appropriately:


  output$LOB<- renderUI({
    if (is.null(input$Client)){
      selectizeInput('LOB', 'Select Line of Business:', choices = c("Commercial","Medicaid","Medicare"), selected = "Commercial", multiple = FALSE)
    }
    else {
      selectizeInput('LOB', 'Select Line of Business:', choices = unique(data$LOB[data$Client %in% input$Client]), selected = unique(data$LOB[data$Client %in% input$Client])[1], multiple = FALSE)
    }
  }) 


When formatStyle is "ON" the above red code does not work in some situations...meaning the UI element does not update to the appropriate "choices" and "selected" values. When formatStyle is commented-out it works perfectly.


I have cleansed the data itself to remove all hidden characters, NAs, and punctuation.


Below is the datatable code:

  

datatable(filteredDrug,                    
              filter = 'top',                  
              rownames = TRUE,
              selection="none",                
              options = list(searchHighlight=TRUE,
                             pagingType= "simple",
                             pageLength = 10,                 
                             server = TRUE,                    
                             processing = FALSE
              )) %>% formatStyle("Drug Utilization",target="row",backgroundColor=styleEqual(colorValues,colorBackground))



Has anyone experienced odd formatStyle errors like this before?
